scope: read-only selected exact-version source and project candidate; no build, container, device, or canonical-plan edit
reason: The old external DSO only copies art::GetFaultMessageForAbortLogging() across a C ABI. Exact AOSP16 ART already preserves the message via android_set_abort_message and emits the fault message from its signal diagnostic path. Exact AOSP16 libbase has Logger/Aborter hooks, while exact OH7 HiLog exposes a C sink. A project libart_log_bridge.cpp candidate wires those hooks to HiLog, but it is not bound to an admitted single-Bionic product/build/runtime and contains historical compatibility comments. No selected-current Bionic consumer of the old DSO was found in the bounded project framework/build source. Thus replacement is directionally justified; retirement or a tested tool disposition is not yet proven.
